text.p: Programme of matches in the
French first division championship this weekend (standings in
parentheses, all kick-off times GMT):
Saturday:
Metz (8) v Auxerre (7) 1500
Both sides, looking to keep in contention for a berth in the
UEFA Cup, have been weakened by international call-ups and
injuries. Auxerre captain Franck Silvestre and winger Bernard
Diomede are set to return after injury.
Lyon (9) v Bastia (4) 1800
The Corsicans, vying for France's second European Cup place in
a tight tussle with Paris St Germain, Nantes and Bordeaux, have
midfielder Cyril Rool suspended and Pole Piotr Swierczewski
doubtful. Lyon, who have won their last three home games, will
be without suspended top scorer Alain Caveglia.
Le Havre (16) v Rennes (14) 1800
Both sides are fighting to avoid relegation. Rennes, who in 17
away games have not won once, welcome back Stephane Guivarc'h,
the scorer of 19 goals, from suspension.
Lens (15) v Lille (17) 1800
Another two sides battling against relegation. Lens striker
Aboubacar Camara is doubtful with a hand injury for what
promises to be a hard-fought derby between the two teams with
the worst home defensive records.
Cannes (13) v Bordeaux (5) 1800
Bordeaux, fresh from a home win over leaders Monaco, field
former Cannes teenager Peter Luccin for injured midfielder
Michel Pavon as they bid to remain in a European qualifying
place after failure to secure a berth when they lost the League
Cup final.
Monaco (1) v Marseille (12) 1800
If Monaco win and PSG do no more than draw on Sunday, the
leaders will lift their sixth league crown. Marseille seek their
first away win of poor season. Four Monaco regulars are absent
on international duty, while Marseille have been weakened by
injuries.
Montpellier (10) v Strasbourg (6) 1800
League Cup winners Strasbourg, without injured Slovakian
goalkeeper Alexander Vencel, will be bracing themselves for a
reaction by Montpellier to their French Cup semifinal loss to
Guingamp last weekend and the end of their 20-match unbeaten
run.
Nantes (3) v Caen (18) 1800
Caen, in desperate need of points to avoid relegation, aim to
end Nantes' 26-match unbeaten run. Nantes, without Tunisia's
Adel Sellimi who is on World Cup duty, welcome back defenders
Jean-Marc Chanelet and Christophe Pignol from injury.
Guingamp (11) v Nancy (19) 1800
Guingamp have left out Polish stopper Marek Jozwiak and
midfielder Yannick Baret, both one booking from suspension which
would put them out of the May 10 French Cup Final. Nancy's
Wilson Oruma is away on World Cup duty with Nigeria.
Sunday:
Paris St Germain (2) v Nice (20) 1630
PSG, without suspended defender Laurent Fournier, should hang
on to a European Cup qualifying place by beating bottom club
Nice, who have goalkeeper Bruno Valencony injured, while
defender Olivier Fugen starts on the bench to minimise the risk
of a booking and automatic suspension which would deny him a
place in the French Cup Final.
